sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach have been strong this season with seven wins from their last ten matches, and will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, with Stafford looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent defeat. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, face mid-table Eccleshall at home, while fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community away in a fixture that could have playoff implications given both sides' mid-table positions. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a match between two mid-table sides with contrasting recent form—Bilston's impressive winning streak versus Foley Meir's inconsistency. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a clash of teams in the lower half, while Crewe host Allscott Heath, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town (both struggling sides), Shawbury United welcome in-form Barnton, and Brereton Social host winless Widnes Town on Saturday before facing Wednesfield Community again on Wednesday evening in a midweek replay of the weekend's fixture.
